_notes: category: anomaly | habitat | raider | crisis | wildcard. research_reward = studying/surviving it grants research progress or a specific tech (anomalies double as research sites). counter_techs = tech ids (data/tech_tree.json) that counter the hazard.

hazards.name: Ion Storm
hazards.effect: Sensors -50%, random system damage, shuttles grounded.
hazards.counter: Wait it out; regenerative shields reduce damage.

hazards.name: Plasma Storm (Badlands)
hazards.effect: Heavy damage over time; ideal raider hideout.
hazards.counter: Navigational deflector upgrades; local guides (Maquis contacts).

hazards.name: Mutara-type Nebula
hazards.effect: Shields and sensors offline inside; visual-range combat only.
hazards.counter: Tactical choice: lure enemies in (Wrath of Khan).

hazards.name: Metreon Gas Cloud
hazards.effect: Weapons fire ignites gas: area explosion.
hazards.counter: Hold fire; or bait enemies into it.

hazards.name: Subspace Rift
hazards.effect: Damages nearby ships; warp in system disabled; firing torpedoes into it can make it expand.
hazards.counter: Research rift-sealing (dekyon/tachyon pulse).

hazards.name: Graviton Ellipse
hazards.spawn: surfaces from subspace without warning, moves
hazards.effect: Pulls and crushes ships in its path.
hazards.counter: Early-warning sensors; get out of the way.

hazards.name: Temporal Anomaly
hazards.effect: Random: ship sent forward in time (vanishes N minutes), aged hull, or duplicated.
hazards.counter: Chroniton shielding tech.

hazards.name: Quantum Rift
hazards.effect: Portal to alternate universe; may spawn Mirror Universe ships.
hazards.counter: Seal or exploit.

hazards.name: Stable Wormhole
hazards.effect: Long-range lane link; strategic chokepoint.
hazards.counter: Fortify (self-replicating minefield tech).

hazards.name: Tholian Web
hazards.effect: Traps ships in a contracting energy net.
hazards.counter: Destroy a weaver before it completes; interphase effects.

hazards.name: Cosmic String
hazards.effect: Extreme gravity; may host 2D lifeforms.
hazards.counter: Avoid; study for big research payout.

hazards.name: Silicon-based Natives
hazards.effect: Miners killed, equipment destroyed.

choices.exterminate: Short-term ore, morale and diplomacy hit

hazards.name: Botanical Plague
hazards.effect: Food production collapses.
hazards.counter: Zenite shipment / zenite_medicine.

hazards.name: Zenite Gas Exposure
hazards.effect: Worker impairment, unrest.
hazards.counter: Filter-mask tech; worker rights policies.

hazards.name: Tribble Infestation
hazards.effect: Food stores drained exponentially.
hazards.counter: Klingon trade partner (they hate tribbles), or a Tribble predator import.

hazards.name: Stellar Flare
hazards.effect: Radiation damages exposed outposts.
hazards.counter: Shielded structures, kelbonite bunkers.

hazards.name: Seismic Collapse
hazards.effect: Deposit lost, population casualties.
hazards.counter: Geological surveys before deep mining.

hazards.name: Pre-Warp Civilization
hazards.effect: Prime Directive dilemma.

hazards.name: Colonial Insurgency
hazards.effect: Maquis-style raids on your own lanes.
hazards.counter: Morale, autonomy, or crackdown (raises insurgency elsewhere).

hazards.name: Orion Syndicate
hazards.behavior: Smuggling, contraband, kidnapping colonists, bribing your governors.
hazards.counter: Security patrols; buy them off; hire them against rivals.

hazards.name: Nausicaan Raiders
hazards.behavior: Hit-and-run on freighters and civilian transports.
hazards.counter: Convoy escorts.

hazards.name: Kazon Sects
hazards.behavior: Swarm attacks; try to steal replicator/transporter tech.
hazards.counter: Play sects against each other.

hazards.name: Hirogen Hunters
hazards.behavior: Track and target your highest-XP ship/captain.
hazards.counter: Decoys, holographic prey (with risks).

hazards.name: Breen Privateers
hazards.behavior: Raid with energy dampeners; strand fleets.
hazards.counter: Dampener-resistant power routing tech.

hazards.name: Borg Incursion
hazards.effect: Cube enters map; assimilates colonies and adapts.
hazards.counter: Rotate weapon types; transphasic torpedoes; coalition fleets.

hazards.name: Species 8472 Invasion
hazards.effect: Bioships destroy planets in formation.
hazards.counter: Nanoprobe-enhanced weapons (requires Borg tech or alliance).

hazards.name: Crystalline Entity
hazards.effect: Strips all organic life from a planet.
hazards.counter: Graviton beam resonance (shatter it) — or hide populations in kelbonite shelters.

hazards.name: Planet Killer
hazards.effect: Neutronium hull; consumes planets for fuel.
hazards.counter: Sacrifice a ship with an overloaded warp core into its maw.

hazards.name: The Burn
hazards.effect: Most active dilithium/warp cores explode; warp travel nearly ceases.
hazards.counter: Era-wide scenario: find the source.

hazards.name: Q Intervention
hazards.effect: Random: trial (pass a challenge for a buff), swap a fleet's location, remove a player's ships temporarily, fling a ship to Borg space.
hazards.counter: None. Q does what Q wants.

hazards.name: Mirror Universe Incursion
hazards.effect: Terran Empire duplicates of your own ships appear via a quantum rift.

hazards.name: Changeling Infiltration
hazards.effect: Hidden saboteur in a colony or fleet; random sabotage until found.
hazards.counter: Blood screenings (morale cost), phaser sweeps.
